name: Copper coils
description: Refrigerant tubing for split AC installations and repairs.
long_description: Soft-drawn copper tubing in pancake coils carries refrigerant between the indoor and outdoor units. The right diameter and wall thickness protect against leaks and pressure loss, especially with high-pressure refrigerants like R32 and R410A.
match_by: Pipe OD, wall thickness and length

parts.name: Pancake copper coils
parts.detail: Soft-drawn coils in 3/16" to 7/8" OD for refrigerant lines.

parts.name: Liquid & suction line pairs
parts.detail: Matched pipe pairs for split AC indoor–outdoor connections.

parts.name: Insulation sleeves & tape
parts.detail: Nitrile insulation and wrapping tape to stop sweating and heat gain.

parts.name: Flare nuts & brazing consumables
parts.detail: Flare nuts, brazing rods and flux for leak-free joints.

signs: Oil stains or frost on pipe joints
